title: Instagram Reels vs Carousels Reach & Engagement Benchmark
sourceTitle: Data Shows Instagram Reels are Best For Reach — But Not Engagement
sampleDescription: More than 4 million public Instagram posts published between January 2022 and October 2024

rankKiwiCalculations.coreTakeaway: Format superiority depends on objective: Reels maximize top-of-funnel reach (+36%), while Carousels maximize engagement depth (+12%).

limitations: Dataset relies on Buffer's user base of brands, creators, and agencies
Reach and engagement metrics are aggregated cross-niche averages
Private accounts and non-Buffer scheduled posts excluded
